title: DejaVu Anemoia
description: The modpack for optimisation and comfort play for Vulkan on 26.2+ on Mac or low-end PCs
body:
The ultimate optimization and comfort modpack for Minecraft 26.2+. Designed to provide a smooth, lag-free experience on Mac and low-end PCs.


Are you tired of low FPS and cluttered interfaces? This modpack is carefully curated to boost your performance using the latest optimization technologies, while adding essential quality-of-life (QoL) features that keep the gameplay feeling close to vanilla.

Key Features:
1. Performance First: Includes high-end optimization mods like Sodium, Lithium, and ImmediatelyFast to significantly improve rendering and reduce CPU overhead.
1.  Improved Gameplay: Adds essential tools like Xaero's World Map, AppleSkin, and Simple Voice Chat for better navigation and immersion.
1.  Enhanced UI: Cleaner inventory management with Inventory Profiles Next and better aesthetic tweaks like Blur+ and Better Mount HUD.
Performance Benchmark:
Tested on MacBook Air M2: Stable ~91 FPS average at 16 render chunks (using 5GB of RAM).


Important Notes:
>  First Launch: The initial launch may fail due to library initialization. Simply restart the game, and it will work perfectly.


>  Compatibility: Highly recommended to use alongside VanillaTweaks for the best visual experience.


- Note for Windows users: While optimized for Mac, this pack may experience performance inconsistencies on certain Windows hardware.
